text: Proposal for the Feature flags for every release work: put every release behind a feature flag. Releases are batched because half-finished features cannot ship.
Worried about stale flags pile up. Can we roll it out to a few accounts first?
Ok if we keep the old path around for a month.
Chiming in from the next team over: this affects us too, please keep us posted.
I can take the first ticket.
Did we consider the other option, 'Release branches per feature'?
Going ahead. Decision record to follow.
